description: NZTA publishes point road events and line road-area events derived from its Traffic and Travel Data System. The source describes notable verified incidents and works affecting state-highway travel, including weather-related disruptions. The schema includes impact, restrictions, planned status, start and end dates, comments and alternative routes. This ArcGIS service exposes event layers; the wider API also describes other services that are not included in this record. No live events or camera images were retrieved. Coverage is New Zealand. Access is through the published ArcGIS feature service. Licence and cost: The source states Creative Commons Attribution 4.0, with accuracy and completeness caveats. Caveats: only item, service and layer metadata were inspected. No feature records were downloaded, and current completeness, geometric quality and operational availability remain untested. Access charges are not stated in the inspected metadata. The resource provides mapped infrastructure or service inputs; applying it in a simulation requires checking the source limits and relevant model assumptions. Related resource: the existing NZTA open-data portal provides the wider catalogue.
